name: jstack
description: Claude Code skills for running many parallel AI coding agents on one machine: /train ships all ready git worktree branches with one build and one PR, /train-compound piles ready branches into one release, /train-queue shows where everything is, a machine-wide heavy-job lock and a hard RAM ceiling keep builds from eating all your RAM, /optimize measures and proves web performance fixes with A/B stats, opt-in guard hooks deny bare typechecks and builds outside the lock and recursive scans over the repo and clean up what subagents leave running, a READY gate checks a branch before it boards, and /grill-me + /wayfinder (from mattpocock/skills, MIT) plan the work first.
